final: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites AS s LEFT JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS overall_avg FROM site_stats), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS status_avg FROM site_stats WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT ss.avg_faces, ss.avg_faces - b.overall_avg AS above_overall, ss.avg_faces - sa.status_avg AS above_status FROM site_stats AS ss JOIN status_avgs AS sa ON sa.entrystat = ss.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE ss.avg_faces > sa.status_avg AND b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_kept_site_faces, AVG(above_overall) AS avg_excess_overall_baseline, AVG(above_status) AS avg_excess_over_status_average FROM kept
